RoomPage.description1: Relax in our Junior Suite, where comfort meets style. These rooms offer a spacious living area and high-end finishes for a perfect stay.
RoomPage.description2: Each suite is designed with modern elegance, ensuring a peaceful atmosphere and premium service during your visit to Samarkand.
RoomPage.specialInstructionsDesc: Guests will receive an email 5 days before arrival with check-in instructions; front desk staff will greet guests on arrival.
RoomPage.childrenDesc: Children are welcome! Kids stay free when using existing bedding. Extra beds are available for $10 per day.

GetInTouch.hotelDescription: Discover a sanctuary where ancient heritage meets modern luxury. Located just steps from the historic heart of Samarkand, Bluecourt Hotel offers a unique boutique experience defined by traditional Silk Road craftsmanship, intricate hand-carved details, and world-class hospitality.
